name: shadow
note: Hector's shadow: drawn by the Xbox with 4X multisampling, onto the back buffer's multisample grid (the SDK's State::rt_back_buffer). At the start of the corridor of 5.2 it falls to the right of his legs, on the lit floor: there the floor is about half as bright (0.58) as a little farther right. Without the shadow both are alike.
